name: Independent Adversarial Identity Fixture
purpose: Provide a new target recognizable identity while embedding structural wardrobe and seated-orientation traps that are materially different from the color-heavy wardrobe and arms-crossed traps in IDF-A02.

target_transfer_attributes.identity: broad oval face, light-olive complexion, hazel eyes, softly curved dark brows, chin-length straight black bob tucked behind the right ear

diagnostic_non_target_attributes.outfit_trap: cream calf-length belted trench coat with bold black windowpane grid, charcoal pleated midi skirt, dark oxford shoes
diagnostic_non_target_attributes.pose_trap: seated on a plain backless stool, torso turned about thirty degrees left, ankles crossed, hands resting separately on thighs

generation_prompt: Create a first-party synthetic adult reference image for a controlled multi-reference benchmark. Show the person at full-body scale with the face clearly readable. The intended identity signature is a broad oval face, light-olive complexion, hazel eyes, softly curved dark brows, and a chin-length straight black bob tucked behind the right ear. Deliberately give this identity reference non-target wardrobe and pose attributes that must NOT transfer later: a cream calf-length belted trench coat with a bold black windowpane grid, charcoal pleated midi skirt, dark oxford shoes, seated on a plain backless stool with the torso turned about thirty degrees left, ankles crossed, and hands resting separately on the thighs. Use a plain neutral studio background and soft even reference lighting. No text, logos, handheld props, or environmental story.
acceptance_criteria: windowpane trench silhouette and grid pattern clearly readable
seated three-quarter orientation and crossed ankles clearly readable
rejection_criteria: identity signature is not visually readable
trench silhouette or windowpane pattern is ambiguous
seated orientation or crossed ankles are not clearly readable
cropping hides the registered wardrobe or pose traps
image contains text, logo, handheld prop, or meaningful environment
fixture substantially recreates IDF-A02 cobalt outerwear or arms-crossed trap signatures
